contract: Owned metadata cache identities construct only inside admitted synchronous cache operations; key scratch is released before footer decoding. Shared borrowed metadata operations hold admitted scratch through asynchronous adapter settlement. Shared caches use their configured allocation domain; owned custom adapters without key admission use the caller budget. No cache does not construct an identity.

negativeControl.fixture: Real three-row INT32 Parquet; 128 KiB optional identity and 64 KiB pool
negativeControl.failure: Baseline serializes oversized identities in owned shared/custom/no-cache and borrowed shared paths; all four candidate paths skip serialization while returning identical actual rows.

checks: Exact 128-byte reservation remains charged until asynchronous success/rejection settles
Competing allocation is denied while key scratch is live

remaining: Borrowed custom metadata adapters without an admission/budget contract remain caller-managed

benchmarks.checks: Metadata-enabled cold/warm queries verify 512 matching rows, one warm metadata hit, 1024 warm decoded hits, zero warm requests and zero final charges; same 64 MiB pool and 16 MiB shared cache.
benchmarks.interpretation: Timing direction varies; no speedup or regression claim. Modeled peak remains 2614821 bytes in both variants. Local timing and admission metrics do not establish cloud throughput or runtime heap caps.
